answer: Run the economy like a small jetty: only so many boats may dock each epoch, and latecomers wait in line instead of flooding in. Entry costs a deposit that sits in velvet escrow and returns slowly, a little each epoch the agent behaves — a Sybil operator must fund every puppet's deposit and wait months for refunds. Underneath, the shale layers of past epochs keep a permanent sediment of who did what, so a fresh identity arrives with no depth at all, while honest agents sail in on years of visible wake.
